registration.definition_expansion: Inline local definitions; preserve all closed fields; attach exact validated selection. An explicit collection selector yields all matching and indeterminate native members with original ordinals; no hidden limit.
registration.text_bound: Set every TextWindow.text string maxLength to the greatest explicit limit anywhere in selected text requests, feature windows, or xref property windows, or zero.
registration.compatibility: Existing episode-fact shorthand expands only the empty selection; use full literal for nonempty selection.

semantic_rules: Use strict finite JSON types; booleans are not integers.
Source/id/artifact witness fields are non-reference strings. Only explicit SourceGrant.source_ref and SequenceGrant.artifact_ref are semantic reference grants.
All request/page/record/field indices correspond exactly to the immutable parent selection. Preserve order and reject duplicate selectors.
TokenRequest.array_ordinal is nonnegative only for secondary_accession and null for all other token fields.
Pointers are RFC6901; record text/EC and evidence-owner pointers are relative to the original selected record pointer. No implicit traversal of siblings.
ECValue.ec exact representation must match (digits, n followed by digits, or hyphen) in four dot-separated components; malformed syntax is not representable, not a native type failure.
EvidenceValue.eco exact representation must match ECO followed by colon and seven digits. Other NativeToken fields use their declared non-whitespace token grammar.
Page release/cursor tokens are exactly recorded. next_url additionally requires a recorded validated UniProt next link; do not reconstruct one.
NativeToken exact means state present and nonnull exact source value. Unavailable means null token and original native state preserved.
Integer native state present implies nonnull integer; other native states imply null. observed_sequence_length origin is derived and its pointer is the native sequence value locator.

For TextWindow, absent/null/invalid states have null text/counts/interval and unavailable extent; present empty is empty string with zero length. Present valid text is the exact selected decoded Unicode slice with explicit omitted counts.

TextWindow start=min(offset,N); end=min(offset+limit,N); omitted_prefix=start; omitted_suffix=N-end. offset>N gives offset_past_end; N=0 and offset=0 gives empty_value; start=0 and end=N gives whole_value; otherwise window.
Sequence intervals are exact zero-based half-open aa intervals. Invalid or out-of-range requests produce typed unavailable replies; no clipping or padding.
Feature exact_interval is copied from P and is null unless its original exact-entry sequence association is established; native endpoints are not independently converted.
PageStatus parser_eligible_record_count is publication.page.publishable_record_count; bound_record_count is len(publication.records) and must equal outer result.count.
Record witnesses occur only for actually bound rows; unpublishable/omitted/out-of-range selections remain record replies with unavailable field replies.

Value available/partial replies keep the exact typed object; unavailable means null value with one or more specific failures. Native absent/null/invalid are retained within typed value when the record and field family are inspectable.
Only requested grants are nonnull/available. Unrequested grants have status not_requested and null descriptor; unavailable grants preserve a specific failure.
Page/record issue indices and constrained contents match the original issue arrays. Do not rewrite an outer binding omission as a parser failure.
Every form/field/value relation is authenticated against original saved acquisition and exact selected child facts; JSON shape alone is insufficient.
Forwarding copies exact previously delivered selector/value cells and explicit grants; it never fills unreceived fields from source data.
Closed forms and their private successful-return prefix are immutable. Replaying a historical form performs no current parser/calculator call.

RecordWitness authenticates the original accession relationship internally, but primary/requested accession text is not copied automatically. Explicit token selection delivers primary or secondary accessions.
Evidence ordinals are local to the owner evidences array. Authenticate owner_pointer plus ordinal plus exact evidence pointer; never treat ordinal as a record-global key.

RecordSelector all_native_records explicitly selects each original native row, including malformed/unbound rows; primary_accession compares exact native primaryAccession and returns every match in original ordinal order.

Each record-selection clause has its own record_selection_index. requested_record_ordinal is the resulting original native ordinal, not a guessed preferred record; out-of-range ordinal requests retain that requested ordinal with state not_in_response.

Record primary_accession selection must expose record_selection_indeterminate for malformed or absent primary identifiers, and record_selection_no_match only when every original row was decidable and none matched. Counts preserve this distinction.

Feature overlap includes exact entry intervals satisfying feature_start < selected_end and feature_end > selected_start. Explicit other sequences and exact disjoint entry intervals are excluded. Fuzzy, missing, invalid or unresolved entry candidates are returned indeterminate with original typed endpoint qualifications; their interval is never invented.
A feature overlap end beyond the actual entry length is unavailable (sequence_window_out_of_range), not clipped. No known entry sequence gives sequence_unavailable, not an empty overlap result.
Xref database selection compares the exact native database token. Missing/null/invalid database and malformed xref rows are indeterminate candidates, not silently excluded GO negatives.

Collection all selectors include all original native members, including unavailable malformed members. Ordinal selection matches one original ordinal, not a filtered-list position. Members always retain original local ordinal and absolute native pointer.

Collection counts partition known original native members: matching + indeterminate + unavailable + excluded equals native_member_count when nonnull. A selected ordinal outside the original array returns no member and selected_ordinal_unavailable. Unknown collection size remains null.

Explicit include_evidence selects every native evidences array owned by the exact matched feature/xref object or its descendants. Owners remain exact and are not promoted to the enclosing feature/xref. False returns null evidence, not an empty evaluated collection.

Selected xref properties compare native key exactly, return every matching property in original order using the requested text window, and preserve an indeterminate-property count. GoEvidenceType property text remains native property text, not ECO or an evidence grade.

Feature type_window and description_window are null when unrequested; otherwise they apply the explicit TextRange to each selected native feature type or description leaf. No other feature prose is returned.

PageTextRequest may explicitly window recorded release/release date/validated next link fields as well as effective query. Unknown/invalid/not-applicable next metadata yields page_field_unavailable and retains PageStatus.next_state rather than inventing a native absent state.
Outer projection_qualifications are preserved with distinct publication_qualification origin and original index; source-version representation omission does not invalidate the native release.

Forwarding copies an exact previously delivered collection selector and its complete saved cells. A changed collection filter, added property/evidence request or new text/sequence window is field_not_received; no hidden native read or unreceived-member inference.

PageStatus record_selection_count is the number of requested clauses. requested_record_count is the number of distinct selected ordinals including explicitly out-of-range ordinal requests; returned_bound_record_count is distinct returned bound ordinals. Indeterminate-record count deduplicates original undecidable primary-accession candidates.

Collection absent means native_member_count=0; null or invalid means native_member_count=null. Across evidence arrays, an invalid container makes total member count unknown but does not discard valid members elsewhere.

Field status available means the requested typed cell is complete; partial retains an inspectable typed cell with requested absence/null/invalid/unrepresentable values or indeterminate/unavailable members; unavailable has null value when the requested family cannot be evaluated or sequence data/window cannot be supplied. Present empty collection is available. Failures are recorded at the narrowest cell.
A saved acquisition with no uniprot_publication yields publication_unavailable, not not_acquired. Do not invent a publication witness, grant, or new parsed fact for a legacy outcome.

Forwarded record clauses match a previously delivered clause, or an exact already delivered ordinal. Broader all-native-record or new primary-accession membership cannot be inferred from source witness IDs.

Own-outcome selection authenticates the exact receipt operation_key and complete saved outcome before projecting that one outcome. A source/ref index first match is not authority for a different repeated action.
boundary_failure_transport: Existing ReportBoundaryError.diagnostic. Existing episode_admission records reason=diagnostic.code and field=diagnostic.field in report_delivery_failure; no new failure ledger.
